examples.text: Dietmar puzzelt jeden Abend zwei Stunden.
Als Berta nach Hause kam, puzzelten ihr Mann und ihre Schwägerin am Esstisch.
Die Kinder haben keine Lust mehr zu puzzeln.
„In mühsamer Kleinarbeit puzzelten wir die Fledermausknöchelchen zu einem kompletten Skelett zusammen.“
„Sie tauschten ihre Rechercheergebnisse aus und puzzelten an den Zusammenhängen.“

translations.source_sense_description: intransitiv: die Teile eines Bildes (Puzzles) zusammensetzen

glosses: Anything that is difficult to understand or make sense of.

examples.text: Where he went after he left the house is a puzzle.

glosses: A game for one or more people that is more or less difficult to work out or complete.
Something made with marvellous skill; something of ingenious construction.
The state of being puzzled; perplexity.
To perplex, confuse, or mystify; to cause (someone) to be faced with a mystery, without answers or an explanation.

examples.text: Mens daily occaſions for themſelves or friends, and the neceſities of common life, require the doing of a thouſand things vvithin the compaſs of a fevv dayes, for vvhich it vvould puzzle the beſt Textman that liveth; readily to bethink himself of a ſentence in the Bible, clear enough to ſatisfie a ſcrupulous conſcience of the lavvfulneſs and expediency of vvhat he is about to do; […]

[H]e has a very ſmart VVit, and is a very ſhrevvd Diſputant in thoſe Points himſelf ſeems moſt puzzled in, and is therein very dexterous in puzzling others, if they be not thorough-paced Speculators in thoſe great Theories.
He is perpetually puzzled and perplexed amidst his own blunders.
The case was that of a murder. It had an element of mystery about it, however, which was puzzling the authorities. A turban and loincloth soaked in blood had been found; also a staff.
When it comes to God’s existence, I’m not an atheist and I’m not an agnostic. I’m an acrostic. The whole thing puzzles me.

glosses: To think long and carefully in bewilderment.

examples.text: We puzzled over the curious-shaped lock, but were unable to discover how the key should be inserted.

glosses: To make intricate or difficult to resolve; to entangle.

examples.text: The Ways of Heav’n are dark and intricate, / Puzzled in Mazes, and perplext with Errors; / Our Underſtanding traces ’em in vain, / Loſt and bewilder’d in the fruitleſs Search; […]
They disentangle from the puzzled skein.
